intent: Compare the reported shares of British Muslims who experienced prejudice and those who did not over the past year.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the reported share of British Muslims who experienced prejudice with the share who did not over the past year.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Among British Muslims over the past year, the reported share who experienced prejudice (70%) is larger than the share who did not (30%).
accept: Shows 70% experienced vs 30% not experienced and conveys that experienced is the larger share.
Displays both shares as parts of the same whole with the 70% share visually dominant.
reject: Shows only the 70% experienced share without the 30% complement.
Shows only the 30% not-experienced share without the 70% experienced share.
Presents the two shares without indicating which is larger or how they compare.

optional_valid: Labeling the 30% complement as 'Not experienced' even though the source label is blank.
Showing the full pie as 100% with both slices labeled.
unsupported_to_avoid: Adding a third category or additional prejudice-related breakdown not present in the table.
Reporting an absolute respondent count, since only percentages are provided.
Comparing across panels, rings, countries, or groups, since the table has a single panel/series.
Treating the 30% derived complement as a printed source value.
review_notes: The intent asks for a comparison of the two reported shares, so a single composition_order unit captures both endpoints and their relative order without splitting into separate share_of_whole units.
r2 is a derived complement (role=remainder, source_type=derived_complement); it is still valid basis for the comparison because the full composition sums to 100%.
No cross-panel or multi-ring scope applies: panel and series are empty for both rows.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
